text.tspan: Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
A rider of a motorcycle must:
Only carry two adults if there is a sidecar
A rider of a motorcycle on a public road needs to ensure that:
Whose responsibility is it to ensure passengers under 14 wear a helmet?:
SECTION E – LIGHT AND HEAVY VEHICLES ONLY
Are only needed on long trips
Are only needed on short trips
